list_child.name: list_expense_claims
list_child.desc: Retrieve the complete set of expense claims currently on record. This includes claims in every status, from newly submitted through fully reimbursed.

get_child.name: get_expense_claim
get_child.desc: Look up a single expense claim using its unique identifier. Returns the full claim record as currently stored.

list_parent.name: list_employees
list_parent.desc: Retrieve the complete roster of employees eligible to file expense claims. This is the full employee directory used for reimbursement processing.

get_parent.name: get_employee
get_parent.desc: Look up a single employee record using its unique identifier. Returns the employee's full profile as currently stored.

delete_child.name: delete_expense_claim
delete_child.desc: Permanently erase an expense claim from the system, removing it from all reports and totals. This action cannot be undone once performed.

set_enum.name: set_expense_claim_status
set_enum.desc: Update the review status of an expense claim to reflect where it stands in the approval workflow. Valid statuses are submitted, approved, reimbursed, and denied.

set_bool.name: flag_policy_exception
set_bool.desc: Mark an expense claim as requiring a policy exception because it falls outside normal reimbursement limits. This is typically used when a manager grants a special allowance.

set_ref.name: reassign_expense_claim
set_ref.desc: Move an expense claim onto a different employee's account, correcting cases where the claim was filed under the wrong person. Use this only to fix misattributed submissions.

send.name: email_employee
send.desc: Send an email notification to an employee regarding their expense claims. Use this to communicate status changes or requests for additional documentation.
